visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male athlete with a headband, wearing a black long-sleeve compression-style shirt with graphics, blue athletic shorts, and red batting gloves, walks across a black tarp spread on a baseball field's artificial turf. He holds a light-colored wooden baseball bat in his right hand. The background reveals the brightly lit interior of a large, modern indoor baseball stadium (dome) with tiered seating filled with spectators in the distance. White text overlays appear at the top. (2) The scene cuts to a medium-full shot from behind the batter. The athlete stands inside a batting cage area. He prepares his stance as another person in a black shirt and cap feeds balls from a blue crate sitting on a red plastic stool. The athlete swings the bat forcefully, hitting a ball. A large white number '1' appears centrally. (3) The athlete continues his practice in a rhythmic sequence. He performs five more swings in quick succession. Each swing is captured from a similar angle. For each successful hit, a corresponding white number ('2', '3', '4', '5', '6') appears as a graphic overlay on the screen. Other players and staff in baseball uniforms are visible in the background, along with the protective netting of the batting cage.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with high-energy electronic trap music featuring a heavy synth bass and crisp hi-hats. There is a low-level stadium background murmur. (2) A sharp, percussive impact sound (wood hitting a ball) occurs with a bright spectral transient. A digital 'whoosh' transition effect immediately follows. Music continues. (3) A second sharp 'crack' sound occurs, followed by another whoosh effect. The beat of the electronic music remains consistent and energetic. (4) A third 'crack' impact is heard, synchronized with a rhythmic musical drop. A transition SFX follows. (5) A fourth high-frequency 'crack' sound is audible as the bat makes contact. Another rapid whoosh follows. (6) A fifth sharp percussive impact occurs. The mix engineer has prioritized the clarity of the hit sound over the background music. (7) A final sixth 'crack' sound is heard, punctuating the end of the sequence. The music swells slightly as the track ends.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase a baseball athlete's batting practice performance in a professional stadium environment, emphasizing the quantity and consistency of his hits through a numbered montage.
